metadata.description: Multi-plugin marketplace: core, infra, and webapp skill bundles for Cursor and compatible agents.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Universal workflow skills — commit, ship, plan, debug, review. Stack-agnostic foundations that work with any project.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Enterprise infrastructure skills — IaC validation, drift/cost/vulnerability triage, cloud IAM and Well-Architected reviews (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes), and baremetal hardening.

plugins.name: webapp
plugins.description: Web application development skills — API review, architecture review, testing, coverage, migrations, design tokens, and a principal-frontend reviewer agent. Optimized for Next.js / TypeScript / React full-stack development.
